hypothesis: New external data (Asian semiconductor equity markets) trade in sessions that close before the same exchange-local-date US open, so they are a candidate lead indicator for SOXL. Test whether that lead is a genuine forecast or only contemporaneous co-movement, and whether any strictly-lagged switch beats SOXX buy-and-hold on return, drawdown and Sharpe.
data_retrieval: Yahoo Finance chart API, 15y daily closes, retrieved 2026-10-10
causality_rule: Only the strictly-lagged alignment (signal at t-1 for the US session at t) counts as forecast evidence. Same-local-date correlation is classified as contemporaneous and is never treated as tradeable.

gates.forecast_textbook: strictly-lagged |IC| above the floor with a tradeable sign
gates.stable_excess: beats SOXX return AND drawdown AND Sharpe on the window with a majority of positive years
gates.promotion: development stable excess confirmed on the reused diagnostic window and at higher cost

stopping: Exactly the pre-registered market set at two costs across two windows; no market, threshold, window or cost tuning after outcomes. Preserve all results, including failures.
limitations: Daily closes only; Asian intraday session timestamps are not retained.
A contemporaneous co-movement is not tradeable and is never counted as forecast power.
No return forecast, model fit or fitted parameter is used.
